classification.difficultyReason: Interprets histogram tail direction and symmetry, then connects these features to box position, whisker lengths and outlier placement to match the displays and name each distribution shape.

content.prompt: Match each histogram a–c with its box plot i–iii and describe the shape of the data distribution.

spec.description: Unshaded boxplot i with uncapped whiskers and two low triangular outliers. Coordinates reproduce graphical positions, not additional numerical givens.
spec.mathematics: Lower whisker approximately 70; Q1 97; median 109; Q3 117; upper whisker 120; low outliers approximately 53 and 61.

spec.description: Unshaded boxplot ii with uncapped whiskers and three high triangular outliers. Coordinates reproduce graphical positions, not additional numerical givens.
spec.mathematics: Lower whisker approximately 50; Q1 53; median 62; Q3 73; upper whisker 95; high outliers approximately 107, 113.5 and 120.

spec.description: Unshaded boxplot iii, uncapped whiskers and no outliers. Coordinates reproduce graphical positions, not additional numerical givens.
spec.mathematics: Lower whisker approximately 54; Q1 73; median 88; Q3 99; upper whisker 117.

spec.description: Seven touching bars, horizontal gridlines at intervals of 2, frequency scale 0–16 and a visible horizontal-axis break before the first class. Light blue fill represents frequencies.

answer.worked: The frequencies rise towards the middle classes and then fall on both sides, giving an approximately symmetric distribution. Box plot iii has balanced whiskers and no one-sided outliers, so a matches iii.

spec.description: Seven touching bars, horizontal gridlines at intervals of 2, frequency scale 0–16 and a visible horizontal-axis break before the first class. Light blue fill represents frequencies.

answer.worked: Most values are in the higher classes, with a tail towards the lower values. The distribution is negatively skewed. Box plot i has its box towards the high end, a longer lower whisker and low outliers, so b matches i.

spec.description: Seven touching bars, horizontal gridlines at intervals of 2, frequency scale 0–16 and a visible horizontal-axis break before the first class. Light blue fill represents frequencies.

answer.worked: Most values are in the lower classes, with a tail towards the higher values. The distribution is positively skewed. Box plot ii has its box towards the low end, a longer upper whisker and high outliers, so c matches ii.
